entities.summary: The Birthplace of Beethoven's mother is a cultural heritage monument in Ehrenbreitstein, on the River Rhine opposite Koblenz, in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Maria Magdalena van Beethoven, mother of the composer Ludwig van Beethoven, was born here in 1746; it is now a museum.
